"""Grasp a table object with one arm and place it into our basket."""
import json, sys
sys.path.insert(0, "/work")
import numpy as np
from robot import tools, target, query
from ora_lib import current, pixels_to_world, Point
import basket as B
import track3 as T

CAM = "head"
JAW_OFFSET_M = 0.1501          # nominal jaw contact centre along local approach from link6
OBJ_Z_IN_BASKET = 0.875        # object centre at release: ~3 cm above the basket rim


def rot_from_quat(q):
    x, y, z, w = q
    return np.array([[1 - 2 * (y * y + z * z), 2 * (x * y - z * w), 2 * (x * z + y * w)],
                     [2 * (x * y + z * w), 1 - 2 * (x * x + z * z), 2 * (y * z - x * w)],
                     [2 * (x * z - y * w), 2 * (y * z + x * w), 1 - 2 * (x * x + y * y)]])


def axis_and_quat(arm, obs):
    p = obs.pose(arm)
    return rot_from_quat(p.xyzw) @ np.array([1.0, 0.0, 0.0]), np.array(p.xyzw), np.array(p.position.xyz)


def ground_pick(text, expect_xy, cam=CAM):
    r = tools.vision_ground(camera=cam, text=text, max_candidates=3)["result"]
    best = None
    for c in r.get("candidates", []):
        bb = c["bbox_xyxy"]; uv = [(bb[0] + bb[2]) / 2.0, (bb[1] + bb[3]) / 2.0]
        p = pixels_to_world(cam, [uv])[0]
        if not p.valid:
            continue
        d = float(np.linalg.norm(np.array(p.xyz.tolist()[:2]) - np.array(expect_xy)))
        if best is None or d < best[1]:
            best = (c, d, p)
    return best


def plan_grasp(arm, target_ref):
    g = tools.grasp_plan(arm=arm, target_ref=target_ref, max_candidates=3)
    if not g.ok:
        return None, g
    cs = g["result"].get("candidates", [])
    for c in cs:
        ikr = c.get("ik_reachability")
        reach = ikr.get("reachable") if isinstance(ikr, dict) else ikr
        if reach:
            return c, g
    return (cs[0] if cs else None), g


def spot_state(oid):
    ents = json.load(open("/work/objects3.json"))
    e = [x for x in ents if x["id"] == oid][0]
    row = T.presence(current(), [e])[0]
    return row


def basket_px(name="ours"):
    return B.object_pixels(current(), name)


def do_object(arm, text, expect_xy, obj_id, label, drop_xy):
    log = {"label": label, "arm": arm, "obj_id": obj_id}
    # 1. locate
    best = ground_pick(text, expect_xy)
    if best is None:
        print("NO GROUNDING for", text); return False, log
    cand, dist, p = best
    log["ground_dist_m"] = round(dist, 3)
    if dist > 0.04:
        print("grounded object is not where expected:", dist); return False, log
    # 2. plan
    gc, g = plan_grasp(arm, cand["target_ref"])
    if gc is None:
        print("no grasp candidate:", g.status, getattr(g, "failure_code", None)); return False, log
    cid = gc["candidate_id"]
    ikr = gc.get("ik_reachability"); log["reachable"] = ikr.get("reachable") if isinstance(ikr, dict) else ikr
    log["grasp"] = cid
    print("grasp candidate", cid, "reachable", log["reachable"],
          "contact", [round(v, 3) for v in gc["contact_pose"]["position_m"]])
    # 3. execute
    r = tools.grasp_execute(candidate_id=cid, rationale=f"place the {label} into our basket in the demonstrated order")
    print("grasp_execute", r.status, r.failure_code, "ok", r.ok)
    log["grasp_execute"] = {"status": r.status, "failure": r.failure_code}
    if not r.ok:
        print(r.explain if hasattr(r, "explain") else r.summary)
        return False, log
    # 4. did the object leave its spot?
    row = spot_state(obj_id)
    log["spot_still"] = row["still"]
    print("after grasp: spot still", row["still"], row["state"])
    if row["state"] == "PRESENT" and row["still"] > 0.6:
        print("object still on the table after grasp -> not held")
        tools.set_gripper(targets={arm: "open"})
        return False, log
    # 5. carry to the basket
    obs = current()
    ax, q, tcp = axis_and_quat(arm, obs)
    obj_now = tcp + JAW_OFFSET_M * ax
    tgt_obj = np.array([drop_xy[0], drop_xy[1], OBJ_Z_IN_BASKET], float)
    new_tcp = tgt_obj - JAW_OFFSET_M * ax
    log["object_now"] = obj_now.round(3).tolist()
    log["new_tcp"] = new_tcp.round(3).tolist()
    # reach guard (read-only)
    rr = query("reach_check", arm=arm, poses=[list(new_tcp) + list(q)])
    ok_reach = rr["results"][0].get("reachable")
    log["place_reach"] = ok_reach
    print("place pose", new_tcp.round(3), "reachable", ok_reach)
    if not ok_reach:
        print("placement pose not reachable -> abort before moving"); return False, log
    m = tools.move_pose(targets={arm: target(Point(new_tcp, "world"), interaction="precision")},
                        speed="normal", slow_approaching=True)
    print("move to basket:", m.status, m.failure_code, "err", m.target_error_m)
    log["move_to_basket"] = {"status": m.status, "failure": m.failure_code, "err": m.target_error_m}
    if not m.ok:
        return False, log
    # 6. release
    gopen = tools.set_gripper(targets={arm: "open"})
    print("release:", gopen.status, gopen.failure_code)
    log["release"] = {"status": gopen.status, "failure": gopen.failure_code}
    if not gopen.ok:
        return False, log
    tools.wait_ticks(ticks=3)
    # 7. retreat straight up
    up = new_tcp + np.array([0.0, 0.0, 0.10])
    mr = tools.move_pose(targets={arm: target(Point(up, "world"), interaction="precision")}, speed="careful")
    print("retreat:", mr.status, mr.failure_code, "err", mr.target_error_m)
    log["retreat"] = {"status": mr.status, "failure": mr.failure_code, "err": mr.target_error_m}
    # 8. verify
    npx, geo = basket_px("ours")
    row2 = spot_state(obj_id)
    log["basket_px"] = npx
    log["spot_after"] = row2["still"]
    print("VERIFY basket object pixels", npx, "spot still", row2["still"])
    good = npx > (log.get("basket_px_before") or 80)
    return good, log

import json, sys
sys.path.insert(0, "/work")
import basket as B, pickplace as P
from ora_lib import current
text, ex, ey, oid, idx = sys.argv[1], float(sys.argv[2]), float(sys.argv[3]), sys.argv[4], int(sys.argv[5])
bv = json.load(open("/work/basket_vol.json"))["ours"]
cx = 0.5*(bv["rim_x"][0]+bv["rim_x"][1]); hx = 0.5*(bv["rim_x"][1]-bv["rim_x"][0])
cy = 0.5*(bv["rim_y"][0]+bv["rim_y"][1]); hy = 0.5*(bv["rim_y"][1]-bv["rim_y"][0])
frac = [(0.0,0.0), (-0.30,-0.35), (0.30,-0.35), (-0.30,0.35), (0.30,0.35)][idx]
drop = (cx + frac[0]*hx, cy + frac[1]*hy)
n0, _ = B.object_pixels(current(), "ours")
print("basket px before:", n0, "drop_xy", [round(v,3) for v in drop])
ok, log = P.manual_pick_place("left", text, (ex, ey), oid, text, drop, n0=n0)
print("RESULT", ok, json.dumps(log, default=str))
json.dump(log, open(f"/work/step_{oid}.json","w"), indent=1, default=str)

def ground_near(text, expect_xy, cam=CAM, tol=0.05):
    r = tools.vision_ground(camera=cam, text=text, max_candidates=3)["result"]
    best = None
    for c in r.get("candidates", []):
        bb = c["bbox_xyxy"]; uv = [(bb[0] + bb[2]) / 2.0, (bb[1] + bb[3]) / 2.0]
        p = pixels_to_world(cam, [uv])[0]
        if not p.valid:
            continue
        d = float(np.linalg.norm(np.array(p.xyz.tolist()[:2]) - np.array(expect_xy)))
        if d <= tol and (best is None or d < best[1]):
            best = (c, d)
    return best


def manual_pick_place(arm, text, expect_xy, obj_id, label, drop_xy, n0=0,
                      grip_frac=0.55, hover_m=0.07, open_first=True):
    """Top-down parallel-jaw pick with a full-open aperture, then carry and release."""
    from ora_lib import Direction, object_geometry
    log = {"label": label, "obj_id": obj_id, "arm": arm}
    got = ground_near(text, expect_xy)
    if got is None:
        print("grounding failed near", expect_xy); return False, log
    cand, d = got
    gg = object_geometry(cand)
    if gg.center_xyz_m is None or gg.principal_axes_world is None:
        print("no geometry"); return False, log
    center = np.array(gg.center_xyz_m, float)
    support_z = float(gg.support_z_m); height = float(gg.height_above_support_m)
    axes = np.asarray(gg.principal_axes_world, float)
    exts = np.asarray(gg.principal_extents_m, float)
    horiz = [(float(np.linalg.norm(a[:2])), float(e), a) for a, e in zip(axes, exts) if abs(a[2]) < 0.6]
    if not horiz:
        print("no horizontal principal axis"); return False, log
    jaw = min(horiz, key=lambda t: t[1])[2]
    jaw = np.array([jaw[0], jaw[1], 0.0]); jaw /= np.linalg.norm(jaw)
    jaw_z = support_z + grip_frac * height
    tcp_c = np.array([center[0], center[1], jaw_z + JAW_OFFSET_M])
    down = Direction([0.0, 0.0, -1.0], "world")
    jawd = Direction(jaw.tolist(), "world")
    log.update({"center": center.round(3).tolist(), "support_z": round(support_z, 3),
                "height": round(height, 3), "jaw_line": jaw.round(3).tolist(),
                "tcp_contact": tcp_c.round(3).tolist()})
    print("object", obj_id, "center", center.round(3), "top", round(support_z + height, 3),
          "jaw_line", jaw.round(2), "tcp_contact", tcp_c.round(3))
    if open_first:
        r = tools.set_gripper(targets={arm: "open"})
        print("open:", r.status, r.failure_code)
    hover = tcp_c + np.array([0.0, 0.0, hover_m])
    r1 = tools.move_pose(targets={arm: target(Point(hover, "world"), approach=down, jaw_line=jawd)},
                         speed="normal")
    print("hover:", r1.status, r1.failure_code, r1.target_error_m)
    if not r1.ok:
        return False, log
    r2 = tools.move_pose(targets={arm: target(Point(tcp_c, "world"), approach=down, jaw_line=jawd,
                                                 interaction="precision")},
                         speed="careful")
    print("descend:", r2.status, r2.failure_code, r2.target_error_m)
    log["descend_err"] = r2.target_error_m
    if not r2.ok:
        return False, log
    r3 = tools.set_gripper(targets={arm: "close"})
    obs = current()
    log["aperture"] = obs.robot_facts["end_effectors"][arm]["gripper"]["measured_opening_normalized"] \
        if isinstance(obs.robot_facts, dict) and "end_effectors" in obs.robot_facts else None
    print("close:", r3.status, r3.failure_code, "aperture", log["aperture"])
    lift = tcp_c + np.array([0.0, 0.0, 0.12])
    r4 = tools.move_pose(targets={arm: target(Point(lift, "world"), interaction="precision")}, speed="careful")
    print("lift:", r4.status, r4.failure_code, r4.target_error_m)
    log["lift_err"] = r4.target_error_m
    if not r4.ok:
        return False, log
